qualification: All original task/evidence/current conditions remain pinned; fresh source and causal efficacy remain unknown. Future execution needs separate preregistration.
rules: One fixed delivered receipt shared by every arm, identical observer digest and declared state ceiling.
Creation/outcome times use original 300-600 second window; outcome observed by receipt delivery and delivery no later than inclusive expiry.
Updates refer to existing arm-local routes and causally preceding shared event IDs no older than 300 seconds; no future or private event.
One route update has a changed bounded integer weight and an observation counter increment of exactly one; count both changed fields.
No no-op, duplicate route, duplicated receipt reuse, unknown fields, missing arm, boolean-as-integer, extra slots or mismatched initial emulator state.
All six arms have identical positive actual proposed changed-field counts; exact candidate/emulator proposals must agree.
Intent validation is not execution, a learning-rule proof, measured actual writes, causal usefulness, independent-task qualification or experiment authorization.
scope: Design-only static validation of symbolic update proposals, not a learner, new prediction task, resource diagnostic or empirical experiment.
stop: One retained static validation result and exact read-only replay. No experiment, scoring, acquisition, tracer or worker launch.
